name: Aísa (Spain)
description: Blue field with a narrow stripe of the bars of Aragon along the hoist bearing a red oval with a white flower, from which a white chevron edged yellow points to the fly, and three yellow eight-pointed stars.
history: Municipal flag of Aísa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe of four red bars on yellow along the hoist
bars of Aragon and oval with a flower
chevron edged yellow pointing to the fly
